svg.aria-label: More enquiries do not produce more completed outcomes
svg.desc: Metric stack: 3 panels, 13 categories, 3 source measures. Top-down order: New enquiries; Completed; Conversion. Independent scales start at zero. New enquiries: +38%; 2.0 → 2.7. Completed: −24%; 233 → 178. Conversion: −5.3pp; 11.9% → 6.6%.

text.tspan: More enquiries do not produce more completed outcomes
Enquiries, completed outcomes and conversion by creation cohort
1) Outcomes belong to the creation cohort, not the outcome month.
Change: average per month, Q4 2025 → Q2 2026; rates use volume weighting
